<ic>The dispersal of 400 Thrones for the purchase of mithril sufficient to raise the army known as the Towerjacks and allow them to operate as an Imperial field army.<br><br>''Proposed by Holberg, seconded by Temeschwar''</ic>

==Overview==
* A request for funds with which to raise the [[Towerjacks]] army in [[the League]].
* The motion was withdrawn as worded, since this does not actually grant permission to ''raise'' the army, just to disburse funds for it.

==Date==
* Withdrawn Summer 379YE
